Theorem 1 (Chapter 127)

Subject: twistor theory | ID: 35639

Corollary

Step 2. Consider the nilpotent operator \(S_{01270012}\) acting on the Frechet space. By the nilpotent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{01270012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01270012\).

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|Q_{01270013}|^p) \leq C_01270013\) follows from the subharmonic Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via perturbative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
